angle: Three toggles buried in iPhone settings that give hours back per charge.
hook: 3 iPhone settings Apple hides that quietly save 4 hours of battery a day
caption:
Every iOS update reshuffles settings until nobody can find them. Three specific toggles are worth 3-4 hours of battery per charge. Background App Refresh alone drains most of your day-battery — for apps you almost never open. Take two minutes and try all three. Which one surprised you the most?

#ProfitPrompts #TechTips #iPhoneHacks #iOS #BatteryLife #Productivity #TechHacks #AppleTips

slides.text: 3 iPhone settings Apple hides that quietly save 4 hours of battery a day
You need 2 minutes and iOS Settings open. That is the whole setup.

items.title: Background App Refresh
items.desc: Settings → General → turn OFF for apps you open weekly, not daily.

items.title: Location: While Using
items.desc: Settings → Privacy → set every app to 'While Using' instead of Always.

items.title: 5G Auto
items.desc: Settings → Cellular → Voice & Data → 5G Auto (not 5G On).

slides.caption: average extra battery per full day after flipping these three toggles

slides.title: Do all 3 in one sitting
slides.body: Open Settings once. Do Background App Refresh first, then Location, then 5G Auto. Ten seconds each. Do not overthink which apps.

slides.text: Apple engineers know Background App Refresh is the biggest drain. They keep it on by default because it makes app-open times feel snappier.
Save this. Flip all 3 tonight and check your battery graph tomorrow evening.
